name: 玫瑰粉调质感精华水款
description: 玫瑰粉调质感面部精华水电商套图模版

styleLock.direction: premium warm-rose botanical facial essence water commerce
styleLock.backgroundSystem: warm ivory field #F7E9EA for benefit, pain and trust pages; matte blush limewash wall #F0CFD6 for the botanical and variant pages; one deep rosewood field #8E3B52 for the macro and closing screens; a honed rose-travertine shelf #EDE0DA as the recurring physical plinth; never water, ripples, grids, mirror plate or glass dishes
styleLock.lightingSystem: warm high-key studio light around 5200K, one large soft front key with a warm fill card, low-contrast soft single-direction contact shadows, one thin specular travelling only down the frosted glass, consistent single light direction on every screen
styleLock.surfaceSystem: honed matte rose-travertine shelf #EDE0DA and blush limewash ground, a folded blush silk ribbon swatch, fresh-cut garden rose blooms and loose matte petals laid flat; never pearls, never a glass watch-dish, never linen over stone, never paper with drafting ruling
styleLock.typography: modern geometric humanist sans-serif; deep rosewood #8E3B52 headlines on warm ivory #F7E9EA, thin short centred rosewood hairline dividers rather than full-width bands; headline 30-42pt, subtitle 15-20pt, label 11-15pt; all rendered copy stays short and placeholder-driven
styleLock.iconSystem: single-weight thin rosewood #8E3B52 outline glyphs drawn inside hexagon frames and small diamond tiles; no circle chips, no node rails, no pills, no oversized or ghost numerals, no metallic or gradient type
styleLock.presentationRules: stable upright product angle and scale for the frosted bottle, product never clipped, label facing camera on the packshot, identical crop and light on comparison panels
noDrift: no color palette changes away from the warm rose set
no water, ripples, bubbles, frozen splash or glass dishes introduced
no grids, laser lines, mirror plates or drafting-paper ruling
no inconsistent lighting or mismatched icon styles
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium warm-rose botanical skincare visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm ivory ground #F7E9EA, blush petal field #F0CFD6, deep rosewood text and accent #8E3B52 and one sage-leaf secondary #7C8B6B; warm high-key studio light around 5200K with a large soft front key and a warm fill card, low-contrast soft contact shadows, one thin specular only on the frosted glass; modern geometric humanist sans-serif; single-weight thin rosewood outline icons inside hexagon frames and small diamond tiles; a matte blush limewash wall with a honed rose-travertine shelf, fresh-cut garden rose blooms and loose matte petals laid flat, never water, ripples, bubbles, grids, mirror plates, pearls or glass dishes; stable upright product scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，把磨砂瓶立于暖玫瑰洞石台架上
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, camera squared to the frame, product standing upright, full product visible
shots.lighting: warm high-key front key with a warm fill card, soft contact shadow, thin specular on the frosted glass
shots.background: honed rose-travertine shelf #EDE0DA against a matte blush limewash wall #F0CFD6
shots.whitespace: generous clear space above the cap
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The bottle standing upright, straight-on eye-level view with the camera squared to the frame, full product visible and not cropped. Warm high-key studio light, large soft front key with a warm fill card, a thin specular running down the frosted glass, a soft contact shadow grounding the product. The product rests on a honed rose-travertine shelf #EDE0DA against a matte blush limewash wall #F0CFD6. No props. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame with generous clear space above the cap. 8K, commercial beauty e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no decorative elements, no cut-off edges, no water or ripples.

provenance.notes: 源为美妆夹下面部精华水套图，逐屏事实：①粉底白渐变首屏，磨砂玻璃瓶配粉色瓶盖立于玫瑰花朵上，右侧四枚圆形卖点牌、左上水纹与露珠；②米白痛点页，菱形拼贴六块缺水困扰卡围绕中央一方女性面颊特写，底部一句流失水量数字；③粉底卖点页，三枚六边形字框配文与斜置瓶身、水滴圆环；④粉色水面漂浮玫瑰花瓣与整朵玫瑰、直立瓶身；⑤上下分屏，上方花瓣水面加说明小字，下方玻璃蒸馏冷凝装置3D渲染与虚线引注；⑥蒸馏装置加温度计虚线引注，下方直立瓶与多枚圆形培养皿成分图；⑦续培养皿成分图与粉绸水面，下方无添加清单逐条罗列；⑧瓶浸粉水与培养皿，方框标注孕妇敏感肌可用，下方分子球泡玻璃结构与滴管；⑨分子球泡与胶囊条带背景、直立瓶，下方产品信息表；⑩粉水水面斜躺两瓶配玫瑰，搭配推荐；⑪顶部粉水光影，产品实拍两格手持磨砂瓶与倾倒于手臂；⑫顶部瓶口滴于手背微距，使用方法两步骤粉色胶囊标配线描圆形示意插画；⑬口碑推荐，五星加博主评价原句加手持实拍；⑭续五星评价加大理石台面实拍，FAQ白卡；⑮FAQ续文加黑色入会角标加二维码。品类判定：参数区品名为面部精华水、用法为洁面后喷于面部、通篇玫瑰花瓣与水面，属承接面部用水的护肤个护/面部护理（非着色彩妆、非身体护理/护手/卸妆/香氛，美妆彩妆下亦无承接面部用水的L2），故 L1=护肤个护、L2=面部护理。已剥离：原中英文品牌字与系列名、店铺与入会角标、二维码、博主评价原句与五星、全部成分专名与百分比/含量/容量/保质期/流失量数字/无添加条数/功效断言，产品一律以 {product} 占位，卖点与标注改为 {callout_n} 空白占位，人物仅写 generic hand 或颈部以下裁切、不沿用原模特面容。与同品类四套近似模版五维差异：（一色板与色温）本套为暖玫瑰调玫瑰象牙#F7E9EA／粉瓣#F0CFD6／玫木#8E3B52／苔叶绿#7C8B6B 且 temperature 为 warm，四套分别钴蓝×奶油#F3EDE4、满版深空靛蓝#171C63、霜雪白#F7FAFD×浅雾青×天青、淡纸草绿#EDF0E4×深松墨绿×赭黄，均无暖玫瑰；（二背景台面与道具）本套用哑光粉陶灰泥墙加玫瑰洞石台架加平铺鲜花花瓣，明确禁用四套的水波纹上升气泡冻结水花、暗场激光网格与玻璃折射板、散珠与透明玻璃表皿或培养皿、方格坐标纸与扇贝撕纸边、干花药剂静物、缎带与色块斜切；（三机位体系）本套以直正平拍加90度侧影微距加正上方俯拍掌心加低角仰视收口的暖调组合，未复刻其格隧道内极低仰视、镜面白台放射晨光、纸面掠射极低微距等招牌机位；（四分镜角色配置）本套新增花水搭配套组俯拍VARIANT、鲜花静物DETAIL、掌心雾面俯拍SCENE三处节奏，且完全不含四套共有的柱形图信任页、双层剖面示意板、节点流程链、圆窗困扰阵；（五版式元件）本套以细玫木六边形字框与菱形拼贴格加无格线参数印记为唯一图形语言，规避幽灵编号大字、超大钛银编号、长虚线关键词导轨、荧光笔标记条、圆序号细轨与空值柱形图。
